archiveTake: One of the archive's cleaner high-pressure sci-fi recommendations when atmosphere and propulsion both need to show up.
spoilerFreeReview: Derelict works because it understands how to scale tension. The sound design is detailed, the threat profile stays legible, and the show rarely forgets that forward motion matters as much as mystery.
It lands best for listeners who want serious sci-fi pressure without losing narrative clarity. The world feels large, but the storytelling keeps the danger close enough to stay urgent.
thoughts: This is the sort of show I reach for when someone wants a darker, more industrial next listen after a bigger genre hit.
It does not try to charm the listener first. It tries to pull them forward, and that usually works.

quote.text: Pressure first, mystery second, and enough sound detail to make both count.
